fields.summary: The owner asked for a documentation polish milestone: some doc examples are rough (giant JSON blobs in CLI commands) and the prose doesn't read in the owner's voice, although milestone 30's constraint doc-prose-humanized already required the humanize skill. Settled: doc examples use plain rhiza add/link/set commands, with rhiza apply mentioned once as the batch and agent path, and no CLI change for it. The voice is checked by the owner: each doc change set's run drafts with humanize and stops at an owner sign-off before merge. Mechanism: a repo workflow named docs (ship-change with signoff = owner), plus a way to pin a change set's workflow from rhiza change new and on an existing draft, since only rhiza request --workflow can today. Scope: README and quickstart, the concepts pages, the agents/runs/custom-workflows pages, and the CLI help wording behind the generated reference (plain and consistent, not in the owner's voice, normal unattended review). Five change sets, all planned now; the three page rewrites depend on the workflow change set. Nothing was left open.
fields.title: Milestone 31 planning: documentation polish, with the owner
